review.editorial: Separate reread added the peer’s actual invitation and reciprocal aim, clarified an ordinary hand-position mistake and tracked each attempt, pause and direction change through a developed scene.
review.continuity_or_facts: Checked the fixed-slot date, two earlier memories, supported ordinary equipment versus magic, announced slow approaches and stopping rules, injury accommodations, and a future role swap rather than a claimed completed one.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed every sentence and local span; phone QA caught the opening guide jumping ahead, so an audited English-only revision brought it nearer source order without changing Chinese or word categories. Fresh beginning, middle and ending previews confirm readable pinyin/character guides.
